title: Hybridization Design and High-Throughput Screening of Peptides with Immunomodulatory and Antioxidant Activities.
authors: Wang, Junyong; Zhang, Rijun; Zhao, Xuelian; Zhang, Jing; Tong, Yucui; Abbas, Zaheer; Li, Zhenzhen; Zhang, Haosen; Si, Dayong; Wei, Xubiao
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接筛选与MD2蛋白高亲和力的免疫调节肽，并构建报告基因细胞系高通量筛选抗氧化肽，但核心对象为肽-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法用于TF-DNA结合建模，仅分子对接作为辅助筛选手段，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: With the increasing recognition of the role of immunomodulation and oxidative stress in various diseases, designing peptides with both immunomodulatory and antioxidant activities has emerged as a promising therapeutic strategy. In this study, a hybridization design was applied as a powerful method to obtain multifunctional peptides. A total of 40 peptides with potential immunomodulatory and antioxidant activities were designed and screened. First, molecular docking was employed to screen peptides with a high binding affinity to MD2, a key receptor protein in the NFkappaB immune pathway. For the in vitro high-throughput screening, we constructed a reporter gene-based stable cell line, IPEC-J2-Lucia ARE cells, which was subsequently used to screen peptides with antioxidant activity. Furthermore, the biocompatibility, immunomodulatory, and antioxidant activities of these peptides were assessed. Among the candidates, the hybrid peptide VA exhibited the strongest immune-enhancing activity through the activation of the NF-kappaB pathway and significant antioxidant activity via the Nrf2-ARE pathway. Additionally, VA demonstrated protective effects against H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative damage in HepG2 cells. This study not only demonstrates the potential of peptide hybridization, but also develops a screening platform for multifunctional peptides. It provides a new tool for the treatment of autoimmune diseases and oxidative stress-related diseases.
abstract_zh: 随着免疫调节和氧化应激在多种疾病中作用的日益受到重视，设计兼具免疫调节和抗氧化活性的肽已成为一种有前景的治疗策略。本研究采用杂交设计作为一种有力方法以获得多功能肽，共设计并筛选了40种具有潜在免疫调节和抗氧化活性的肽。首先，利用分子对接 (molecular docking) 筛选与MD2（NFkappaB免疫通路中的关键受体蛋白）具有高结合亲和力的肽。对于体外高通量筛选，我们构建了基于报告基因的稳定细胞系IPEC-J2-Lucia ARE细胞，并随后用于筛选具有抗氧化活性的肽。此外，评估了这些肽的生物相容性、免疫调节和抗氧化活性。在候选肽中，杂交肽VA通过激活NF-kappaB通路表现出最强的免疫增强活性，并通过Nrf2-ARE通路显示出显著的抗氧化活性。此外，VA对H(2)O(2)诱导的HepG2细胞氧化损伤具有保护作用。本研究不仅展示了肽杂交的潜力，还开发了一个多功能肽筛选平台，为自身免疫性疾病和氧化应激相关疾病的治疗提供了新工具。
